name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I cooked in restaurants for over 15 years before I moved into software, and I later sold a customer loyalty platform at Fivestars. So when Bridg talks about turning POS data into a real picture of who a restaurant's guests are, I understand both sides: what the operator needs from it, and why the data matters to the marketers on the other end.

Since then I've worked in customer success across martech and data. At Birdeye I onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners on a data-aggregator and listings platform and kept all but one of them, partly by watching usage data and stepping in before an account went quiet. At Level Agency I built ROI and CAC reporting for accounts spending $20K+ a month on ads and walked clients through it in QBRs. Reading a dashboard and saying what it means in plain English is most of what I do now at Solenzo.

My background is deeper than the 1-2 years you list, and I'm applying on purpose: I'd rather work with existing clients and help them get more out of a product than chase new ones, and retail media and identity data is where I want to build expertise. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
